Graduate Programs
Elevate Your Career at the Maxine Goodman Levin School of Urban Affairs!
Join one of the top graduate programs in the nation, consistently recognized by U.S. News and World Report. Our accredited programs prepare you to lead and innovate in diverse urban environments. Whether you're a full-time student aiming to complete your degree in two years or a part-time, mid-career professional seeking flexibility, Levin has the program for you.
Contact Us
Levin Student Services Center
Telephone: 216.687.4625 | E-mail: levinstudents@csuohio.edu
Programs
Master of Public Administration
Our NASPAA-accredited MPA program prepares you to address complex community challenges and lead in dynamic urban settings. You’ll build leadership skills, understand public policy and management, and participate in interactive learning that connects you with the community.
Master of Urban Planning and Development
Our PAB-accredited MUPD program gives you the skills to transform cities and communities. You'll learn to assess urban conditions and gain expertise in urban design, sustainability, and community development. Our curriculum combines hands-on activities with faculty research to inspire innovative ideas for creating livable, fair, and vibrant cities.
Master of Nonprofit Management
The Master of Nonprofit Management (MNM) program enables students to develop management skills and deepen their understanding of nonprofit administration. This program enhances your employment opportunities and empowers you to advance the organizations you serve.
Master of Science in Urban Studies
Master of Science in Urban Studies (MS) program prepares students to assume leadership roles in organizations, to analyze urban systems, and to develop creative and effective strategies for urban revitalization. Specializations include: Community and Neighborhood Development, Economic Development, Public Finance, Urban Real Estate Development, and Urban and Public Policy.
Dual Degree Programs with Law
The combined curriculum leading to the degrees of Juris Doctor and one of three graduate programs is designed to permit the full-time student to complete both degrees over a maximum of four years instead of the five years that would normally be required to complete the two degrees separately. JD/MA degrees are offered in the following fields:
JD/Master of Public Administration
JD/Master of Urban Planning and Development
PhD in Urban Studies and Public Affairs
The Doctoral Program in Urban Studies and Public Affairs integrates urban-related knowledge from a number of academic disciplines. Through disciplinary integration, doctoral students analyze, design, test, and evaluate strategies for urban policy making and management within the public and private sectors.
Graduate Certificates
The Maxine Goodman Levin School of Urban Affairs offers numerous Graduate Certificates for graduate students who wish to seek a specialization in addition to a Master’s degree.
Environmental Sustainability
Local Government Management
Nonprofit Management
Society 5.0
Urban Geographic Information Systems (GIS)
Urban Real Estate Development
